verdict.rationale: Otter documents an official MCP Server that connects meeting data to Claude, ChatGPT and other AI chat tools. The docs say it lets those tools search transcripts across all time periods, recap meetings, and work with action items, using OAuth with granular per-meeting authorization. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described, and a detailed tool reference or setup docs covering generic MCP clients and plan availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an official MCP server lets Claude or any MCP client query my meetings — search, transcripts, action items — with OAuth, no glue code

citations.quote: ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI chat tools can securely access your meeting knowledge through Otter's MCP Server for deeper analysis and smarter workflows.
Connect Otter.ai meeting transcripts and action items to Claude via MCP. Search, recap, and draft follow-ups without leaving the chat.
Search your meeting transcripts across all time periods
OAuth-authenticated with granular permissions. Your AI assistant can only access meetings you explicitly authorize
Otter's MCP Server connects your meeting data directly to AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT, bringing your meeting intelligence into your everyday AI workflows.
